2026-10-14.heading: Saint of the Day
2026-10-14.name: Saint Jude the Apostle
2026-10-14.story: Jude was one of the Twelve apostles, not Judas Iscariot. At the Last Supper he asked Jesus why he would reveal himself to his disciples and not to the world. Jesus answered by speaking of love, keeping his word, and making a home with those who love him. Jude invites us to listen and live that love.
2026-10-14.provenance: Brief story based on Benedict XVI’s October 11, 2006 audience.
2026-10-14.bookDek: Read and listen together to Jude’s question and Jesus’ answer.
2026-10-14.bookCredit: Imaginative storybook illustration, not a historical portrait.
2026-10-14.sourceLabel: Feast source: Maronite Eparchy of Saint Maron, Canada
2026-10-14.bookAlt: Illustrated Jude among the apostles in the children’s storybook

2026-10-15.heading: Saint of the Day
2026-10-15.name: Saint Teresa of Jesus (Avila)
2026-10-15.story: Teresa lived in sixteenth-century Spain, at the time of Martin Luther, and worked to bring significant reform to the Carmelite Order. A great teacher of prayer, she was the first woman proclaimed a Doctor of the Church, together with Catherine of Siena. She is a patroness of Catholic writers.
2026-10-15.provenance: Brief story based on Vatican News' saint of the day.
2026-10-15.sourceLabel: Feast source: Vatican News saints calendar

2026-10-16.heading: Saint of the Day
2026-10-16.name: Saint Hedwig of Silesia
2026-10-16.story: Hedwig was a duchess of Silesia and Poland who showed that true nobility means serving those most in need. She later lived as a religious in a Cistercian monastery.
2026-10-16.provenance: Brief story based on Vatican News' saint of the day.
2026-10-16.sourceLabel: Feast source: Vatican News saints calendar

2026-10-17.heading: Saint of the Day
2026-10-17.name: Saint Ignatius of Antioch
2026-10-17.story: Ignatius was an early second-century bishop of Antioch. Led to Rome as a prisoner, he wrote seven letters that remain a precious witness to the faith of the Apostolic Church. There he was thrown to wild beasts and became, in his own words, Christ's pure bread.
2026-10-17.provenance: Brief story based on Vatican News' saint of the day.
2026-10-17.sourceLabel: Feast source: Vatican News saints calendar

2026-10-18.heading: Saint of the Day
2026-10-18.name: Saint Luke the Evangelist
2026-10-18.story: Luke wrote the third Gospel and the Acts of the Apostles. A physician and the most vivid portraitist among the Evangelists, tradition remembers him as a painter, and the Church honors him as the patron of artists.
2026-10-18.provenance: Brief story based on Vatican News' saint of the day.
2026-10-18.sourceLabel: Feast source: Vatican News saints calendar

2026-10-19.heading: Saint of the Day
2026-10-19.name: Saints John de Brebeuf, Isaac Jogues and Companions
2026-10-19.story: Six French Jesuit priests, a Jesuit lay brother, and a layman carried the Gospel to the indigenous peoples of New France and gave their lives as martyrs. The Church remembers them as the Canadian Martyrs, the seed of the Church in North America.
2026-10-19.provenance: Brief story based on Vatican News' saint of the day.
